content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 (auth missing at time of service); this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, so those routes are closed, and resubmitting or correcting data won't cure a missing auth. Billing the patient is improper since a provider-caused authorization failure is not the member's contractual share, and write-off prematurely forfeits $751.68 with 150 days of filing time left. The only legitimate remaining avenue is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity of the 93229 monitoring for the documented atrial fibrillation/syncope workup, so I'll file that appeal on this touch.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
